issues.summary: Whole-request semantics and final side-effect authorization now block read-only, reported, hypothetical, quoted, negated, deferred, and explanatory wrappers from becoming state-changing actions.
Pending graph replacement now requires executable request semantics plus a typed pending graph-correction phrase.
Derived H2H/V2V/triad work is bounded and lazy instead of eagerly materializing large projections.
Unavailable over-budget V2V density/projection state is represented as not-computed/over-budget, not as a successful zero result.
Clique/projection exports now refuse over-budget materialization with an explanatory preview instead of producing misleading empty/header-only output.
JSON hyperedge normalization validates object shape, vertex arrays, finite weights, and plain attributes before graph commit.
Custom Parser safety scans ignore comments/strings and avoid false positives for harmless row fields while preserving host/global blocks.
Custom Parser serializability checks reject true cycles while allowing shared acyclic aliases.
Local model setting updates report unchanged state truthfully while remaining compatible with older adapters.
Submission request coordinator owner-token behavior was inspected and preserved.
Local runtime bridge now enforces strict request-body limits before forwarding.
Local runtime bridge now validates numeric env limits and bounds upstream timeout/response reading.
Upload handling now uses shared count/size limits and bounded read concurrency.
CSR/CSC optional metadata vectors are validated for exact length and finite numeric values.
Duplicate hyperedge signatures use unambiguous JSON serialization; zero weights and metadata are preserved.
Falsy-but-valid values such as weight 0 are not treated as missing or absent.
Build/test/lint validation passed; interactive browser smoke was not run in this environment and is not claimed as passed.
Tools tabs now expose tablist/tab/tabpanel semantics with roving keyboard navigation while preserving mounted panels.
Release identity, docs, package metadata, audit override, and portable packaging rules were updated for v7.3.12.
